answer: On LibriSpeech test-clean, the streaming TTS model achieves a 4.7% WER, which outperforms Vall-E’s 5.9% WER but is worse than NaturalSpeech 3’s 1.81% WER [Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue, arXiv:2410.00037v1, PDF p. 31, §5.7 Streaming ASR and TTS].
